personality_one_liner: Modern minimal agriculture with a fresh agri-green palette, focusing on pristine data immersion and operational clarity.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room. Cards never flush to screen edges; always keep md to lg padding. Use intentional whitespace to separate data rather than heavy borders or dividers.

do's: Apply to bottom tab bar and sticky headers over scrolling lists.
Use on floating action buttons (FABs) when layered over content.
Use as overlay on hero cards with photo backgrounds.
dont's: Do not apply glass to data cards, form inputs, or regular list items.
Never stack multiple glass layers inside each other.

screens.name: Auth
screens.purpose: Secure entry via Email or Google.

states.error: Toast or inline message with retry button

screens.layout: Clean hero image at the top with a gradient scrim fading to surface. Form inputs in a single column with labels above. Sticky primary CTA at the bottom.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: Provide aggregate stats for produce, sales, and investments daily/weekly/monthly.

states.empty: Illustration of an empty field with prompt 'Add your first farm to view analytics'.
states.error: Retry connection prompt covering full screen.

screens.layout: Minimalist card-based layout. Shadowless cards with 1px border. Large typography for percentages (e.g., 92% Health). Use linear progress bars instead of complex charts. Horizontal scroll for quick metric categories.

screens.name: Farms & Produce
screens.purpose: List farms and manage their respective produce, sellers, and investments.

states.empty: Basket illustration with 'No produce added yet. Tap + to start'.
states.error: Unable to load farms error with Retry.

screens.layout: List items with 56pt tappable height. Leading visual (photo or tinted initial), bold title, and chevron. FAB (glass) at bottom right to add new Farm/Produce.

screens.name: AI Assistant
screens.purpose: Chat interface for analytics, suggestions, and photo-based disease detection.

states.empty: Greeting from AI with suggested prompt chips (e.g., 'Analyze Profit', 'Detect Disease').

screens.layout: Standard chat feed layout. A sticky prominent action bar for 'Upload Photo'. When a photo is uploaded, show it in a rounded container with a glass overlay analysis card.

screens.name: Market & Community
screens.purpose: Subscription-gated marketplace to sell produce and connect with Farm Friends.

states.empty: Unlock Marketplace empty state with padlock icon and subscription CTA.

screens.layout: 2-column grid layout for market products. For community, vertical feed of posts. Subscription gate must use a premium glass-morphic hero card to prompt upgrade.

produce_market.alt: Basket filled with fresh harvested vegetables

disease_detection.alt: Close up of plant leaf disease

instructions_to_main_agent: IMPLEMENT THE DARK MODE: I've provided 'dark_mode_colors' inside the 'color' object. Set up the theme provider to switch between light and dark modes explicitly as requested by the user.
NO BLUES OR PURPLES: Strict adherence to the fresh agri-green palette. Do not default to generic blue colors for primary buttons, links, or system icons.

HERO SCRIMS: Ensure that anytime text sits on top of the hero_landscape or produce_market images, a top-to-bottom linear gradient scrim (transparent to at least 70% surfaceInverse) is applied behind the text.

DASHBOARD LAYOUT: Use 'Minimal Data Immersion' principles based on web research. Strip away heavy borders; use 1px subtle borders (color: border) with shadow_tier 1. Prefer large clean numbers and progress bars over complex pie charts.
STICKY CTAS: For the 'Add Farm/Produce' forms, the primary Submit button must be sticky at the bottom inside a KeyboardAvoidingView.

AI CHAT & PHOTO: The AI Assistant needs a prominent affordance to upload a photo for disease detection. This is a core feature; make the 'Camera/Upload' button easily accessible next to the chat input.
GLASSMORPHISM: Apply glass effects (expo-glass-effect / expo-blur) to the bottom tab bar and header over scrollable content. Ensure foreground readability.
